name: quay-dev
description: DOGFOOD-ONLY marketplace for THIS repository's working tree (the ./quay entry is a symlink to ../../plugin). It exists so this repo's sessions load the dev plugin as quay@quay-dev while every other project on the machine uses the published `quay` marketplace (github yaleh/quay). A directory marketplace owns one machine-wide name slot, so the dev tree must not register under `quay`. Register it at USER scope with this directory's absolute path (machine-specific, never committed): `claude plugin marketplace add <repo>/dev/quay-dev-marketplace --scope user`. Not shipped: dist-plugin and release builds take only the plugin/ subtree.

plugins.name: quay
plugins.description: The quay plugin from this working tree (plugin/), loaded in place for dogfooding.
